Perform an independent documentation-only novice replay using only these public entry points: https://www.minddy.app/self-hosting and https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/v0.10.27/docs/self-hosting-clean-room.md . Do not inspect the local repository, other agents, issue history, chat history, credentials, or existing local validation reports. Work in a new temporary directory using only anonymous public downloads. Follow public links as needed. Record the exact prompt, UTC timing, URLs followed, deployment-mode choice and responsibilities, required inputs, immutable artifact verification, proposed installation/first-account/project/issue/MFA/integration/fault recovery/backup/update/blank restore/rollback commands and actions, and every genuine missing instruction or contradiction. Review v0.10.27 as the published baseline; the next corrected release is currently being published, so lack of that next tag during this run is an external prerequisite, not a documentation defect. Do not execute application stacks or send external messages. Clearly distinguish documentation replay from executed lifecycle tests and unavailable human novice validation. Produce an English redacted report with actionable findings and your proposed end-to-end path; do not invent successful installation or test evidence. Keep scope bounded to this public documentation replay; no security pentest or broad review.

The next immutable public release is now published: https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/releases/tag/v0.10.28 and https://github.com/mangue-dev/minddy/blob/v0.10.28/docs/self-hosting-clean-room.md .
